text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At Symboli Rudolf's request, I<n>accompany her to a
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Listen to that silence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The air itself seems pure somehow. I<n>feel as
though it's cleansing me from<n>the inside out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Constantly questioning ourselves...<n>Striving to do
our best... These things<n>drive us forwards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But as we forge ahead, our feet grow<n>dirty and our
eyelids heavy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's important to visit<n>places like this
from time to time. So<n>that we may empty our minds
and<n>return to whence we began.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But there I go again, lapsing into a<n>lecture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Shall we head to the altar?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now that blew the cobwebs<n>away. I feel light
in body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, with the benefit of<n>a clear mind, I
can see the answer to<n>a thorny problem I was
wrestling<n>with.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quickly, back to the academy! I must<n>commit this to
paper!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems to have perked<n>up
considerably. The shrine visit must<n>have done her
good.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We approach the altar and put our<n>hands together,
when...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late! There was this lost kid<n>at the
station...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're such a Goody<n>Two-Shoes! We're on
a schedule<n>here—keep with the tempo!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tempo... tent pole...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tent pole... temple... shrine? Aha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oho... I just thought of something<n>rather marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A crow suddenly swoops down at us!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Are you hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, that felt rather like a warning<n>from the shrine
itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suspect it was chiding me for getting<n>distracted
while praying and making a<n>joke of its name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, it may rest assured that I have<n>learned my
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our tranquil outing has an<n>unexpectedly foreboding
ending.
